screening_decisions.reason: Not an RCT. This is a before-and-after observational study comparing PHC villages with non-PHC villages. No randomization was performed.
While this is an RCT, it tests malaria chemoprophylaxis administered by TBAs, not TBA training. The intervention is the drug (Maloprim vs placebo), not training of TBAs.
Not an RCT. This is an observational study comparing outcomes among women delivered by trained TBAs, those given tetanus toxoid, and controls. No randomization described.
Not an RCT. This is a field trial with intervention and control areas, but no randomization is described. Focuses on pneumonia management training, not TBA training for pregnancy outcomes.
This is a Cochrane review protocol, not a primary RCT. Reviews do not meet the eligibility criteria.
Methodological paper about funnel plot asymmetry in meta-analyses. Not related to TBA training or pregnancy outcomes.
Not an RCT. This is a survey instrument validation study examining women's recall of obstetric complications. No TBA training intervention.

While this is an RCT, it compares two training methods (lecture vs interactive) for TBAs. Both groups received training; there is no comparison of trained vs untrained TBAs or additionally trained vs trained TBAs. Outcomes measured are KAP scores, not pregnancy/health outcomes.
Not an RCT. Villages were chosen for intervention vs control but no randomization is described. Primary intervention is village health workers, not TBA training.
Not an RCT. Communities were 'randomly selected' for comparison but the study design is observational/comparative, not a randomized controlled trial of TBA training.
This is a review/critique of a meta-analysis, not a primary RCT. Does not meet eligibility criteria.

Cluster randomized controlled trial. Birth attendants were cluster randomized to intervention (training in neonatal resuscitation + amoxicillin) vs control (standard care/basic skills). Directly compares trained vs untrained TBAs on neonatal mortality outcomes.
Narrative review article summarizing systematic reviews and meta-analyses. Not a primary RCT.
Retrospective case series from a teaching hospital. Not an RCT and not related to TBA training.
Time-series experimental study, not an RCT. No randomization described. Measures knowledge/practice, not pregnancy outcomes.

Cluster-randomized controlled trial. Seven subdistricts randomly assigned to intervention (TBAs trained + delivery kits + integration with health system) vs control (usual care). Compares women in areas served by trained TBAs vs areas without such services.

While this is a cluster-RCT, the intervention is women's groups. All clusters received basic TBA training, so there is no comparison of trained vs untrained TBAs. The intervention being tested is not TBA training.
Systematic review of maternal death causes. Not a primary RCT.
Quasi-experimental design with before-and-after comparison in intervention vs non-intervention communities. No randomization described.
Cluster-RCT but intervention is breastfeeding promotion through health/nutrition workers. TBAs provided some counselling but this is not a TBA training study.
Longitudinal study with intervention and comparison areas, but no randomization described. Multi-component intervention not focused solely on TBA training.
Observational cross-sectional study comparing outcomes by place of delivery. Not an RCT and no TBA training intervention.
Policy document describing Safe Motherhood Initiative priorities. Not a primary research study or RCT.
Abstract describes qualitative study on Episcopal priests' identity work - completely unrelated to maternal health or TBA training. Title-abstract mismatch suggests incorrect indexing.
Community randomized trial but intervention is nutrition/breastfeeding counselling through multiple channels. TBAs were one channel but this is not a TBA training study.
Methodological paper about statistical tests for publication bias in meta-analyses. Not related to TBA training.

Contains a cluster-randomized controlled trial component (Neonatal Resuscitation Program). Birth attendants in clusters were randomly assigned to receive NRP training vs control. Compares trained vs untrained birth attendants on neonatal/perinatal mortality outcomes.
Prospective study validating women's recall of obstetric complications. Not an RCT and no TBA training intervention.
Cross-sectional survey of TBA knowledge, attitudes, and practices. Not an RCT and no training intervention evaluated.
Field trial with intervention and non-intervention areas, but no randomization described. Tests misoprostol administration by TBAs, not TBA training per se.
Review article on neonatal mortality epidemiology. Not a primary RCT.

Cluster-randomized trial but primary intervention is delivered by Lady Health Workers working with TBAs. The intervention package is not TBA training; TBAs are collaborators, not the primary target of training.
Validation study of verbal autopsy methodology. Not an RCT and not related to TBA training.
